title: Betty Andreasson Luca told that Nordic angels brought Christ
place_text: Andreasson family home; underground or underwater location

tellings.quote: And these tall angelic beings told her that they brought Christ into the world and don't worry, they're going to bring him back again soon.

plain: A woman named Betty Andreasson Luca is said to have been taken in the 1960s from her family home to a place underground or underwater, where tall, angel-like, fair-haired beings told her they had brought Christ into the world and would soon bring him back. The researcher Jason Jorjani retells it on Michels's show, also naming her daughter Becky Andreasson, without citing a source. He tells it to back his idea that beings from elsewhere shaped human religion.
